text:
```yaml
name: Auto-regenerate cargo-vet exemptions for Dependabot PRs

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - Cargo.lock
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize

jobs:
  auto-regenerate-exemptions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install cargo-vet
        run: cargo install cargo-vet

      - name: Verify PR is from Dependabot
        id: verify-pr
        uses: jesusvasquez333/verify-pr-label-action@v1.4.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          valid-labels: dependabot
          pull-request-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

      - name: Regenerate cargo-vet exemptions
        if: steps.verify-pr.outputs.valid == 'true'
        run: cargo vet regenerate exemptions --manifest-path Cargo.toml

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.verify-pr.outputs.valid == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add Cargo.vet.exemptions
          git commit -m "Auto-regenerate cargo-vet exemptions"
          git push origin HEAD:$GITHUB_REF
```
